La racine carrée (square root en anglais) est l'une des notions mathématiques les plus recherchées au monde. De nombreux étudiants et professionnels recherchent un calculateur de racine carrée pour résoudre rapidement leurs équations. La racine carrée d'un nombre est la valeur qui, multipliée par elle-même, redonne ce nombre de départ. Si vous multipliez 7 par 7, vous obtenez 49. Donc la racine carrée de 49 est 7. Cette opération inverse l'élévation au carré. En termes mathématiques, la racine carrée d'un nombre x est le nombre y tel que y × y = x (ou y² = x). Anatomie d'une Expression sous Radical Click or hover over any part √ 49 = 7 √ Symbole du Radical (√) Le signe mathématique indiquant l'extraction de racine 49 Radicande (Nombre) Le nombre situé sous le radical (ex. 49 dans √49) 7 Racine (Résultat) Le résultat obtenu (ex. 7) √4 = 2 car 2 × 2 = 4 √9 = 3 car 3 × 3 = 9 √16 = 4 car 4 × 4 = 16 √25 = 5 car 5 × 5 = 25 √100 = 10 car 10 × 10 = 100 Visualisation : Trouver la longueur du côté d'un carré à partir de son aire totale Mode d'Emploi Comment Utiliser le Calculateur Racine Carrée Trois étapes suffisent pour obtenir votre résultat : 1 Entrez Votre Nombre Saisissez n'importe quelle valeur (entier, décimal, fraction ou négatif) dans le champ ci-dessus. 2 Cliquez sur Calculer Appuyez sur le bouton Calculer pour traiter immédiatement votre valeur avec une précision absolue. 3 Lisez Votre Résultat Le calculateur affiche le résultat décimal, la forme radicale simplifiée (ex. √72 = 6√2) et le détail étape par étape. C'est aussi simple que cela. Aucune formule préalable n'est requise pour utiliser l'outil en ligne. Notation & Exposants Notation de la Racine Carrée : Le Symbole √ et x^(1/2) Le symbole √ s'appelle le radical. Lorsque vous écrivez √36, vous vous demandez quel nombre multiplié par lui-même donne 36. La réponse est 6. √ Symbole radical de l'opération 36 Radicande sous le symbole 6 Racine principale non négative Une expression de racine carrée comporte trois éléments : le symbole radical (√), le radicande (le nombre sous la racine) et la racine (le résultat). On peut également écrire une racine carrée sous forme d'exposant fractionnaire : Forme Radicale (√x) Forme Exposant (x^½) Code / Syntaxe √x = y  ⟺  y² = x Standard mathematical radical sign x^(1/2) = √x  ⟺  49^(1/2) = 7 Fractional power notation used in advanced algebra Math.sqrt(x) /* JavaScript */  |  x ** 0.5 /* Python */ Syntax used in programming and scientific calculators Ces deux formes sont strictement équivalentes. Les calculatrices et langages de programmation utilisent fréquemment x^(1/2) car cette forme est simple à manipuler. Équivalence entre le symbole radical √ et l'exposant fractionnaire x^(1/2) Formule Fondamentale Quelle Est la Formule de la Racine Carrée ? Contrairement à l'aire d'un disque, il n'y a pas une seule formule de calcul direct. La racine carrée est définie par une relation réciproque : If y = √x, then y × y = x  (or y² = x) En clair : quel que soit le nombre trouvé, le multiplier par lui-même doit redonner le nombre d'origine. C'est sur cette relation que reposent tous les algorithmes de calcul. Convention de la Racine Carrée Principale La racine carrée principale est la valeur non négative qui vérifie la relation. Par exemple, 5 et -5 vérifient tous deux x² = 25, mais par convention internationale, √25 = 5. Principal Root √25 = +5 Dual Algebraic Solutions x² = 25 ⇒ x = ±5 Propriétés Clés Les Cinq Propriétés Essentielles des Racines Carrées Ces cinq règles permettent de simplifier et de manipuler rapidement les radicaux en algèbre et en géométrie : 1 1. Règle du Produit √(a × b) = √a × √b (pour a ≥ 0, b ≥ 0) √(a × b) = √a × √b Exemple : √(4 × 9) = √4 × √9 = 2 × 3 = 6. Et directement : √36 = 6. Permet de décomposer une racine en facteurs pour la simplifier (ex. √72 = √(36 × 2) = 6√2). 2 2. Règle du Quotient √(a / b) = √a / √b (pour a ≥ 0, b > 0) √(a ÷ b) = √a ÷ √b Exemple : √(16/4) = √16 / √4 = 4 / 2 = 2. Et directement : √4 = 2. Permet de calculer la racine d'une fraction en séparant le numérateur et le dénominateur. 3 3. Règle de la Puissance √(a²) = |a| (valeur absolue de a) √(a²) = |a| Exemple : √(7²) = √49 = 7. Le carré et la racine s'annulent. Élever au carré puis extraire la racine redonne la valeur initiale en valeur absolue. 4 4. Auto-Multiplication √a × √a = a √a × √a = a Exemple : √13 × √13 = 13. √5 × √5 = 5. Multiplier une racine par elle-même redonne le radicande. Essentiel pour rendre rationnel un dénominateur (1/√5 = √5/5). 5 5. Racines Imbriquées √(√a) = a^(1/4) (racine quatrième) √(√a) = a^(1/4) Exemple : √(√16) = √4 = 2. Et 16^(1/4) = 2. Prendre la racine d'une racine donne la racine quatrième du nombre initial. Décomposez le nombre en produit de facteurs premiers 2. Regroupez les facteurs identiques par paires 3. Sortez un facteur de chaque paire hors du radical 4. Multipliez entre eux les facteurs sortis √144 → 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 → (2×2) × (2×2) × (3×3) → 2 × 2 × 3 = 12 √72 → 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 → 6 stays outside, 2 stays inside → 6√2 (≈8.485) Méthode 3 : Méthode de la Potence / Division Longue Algorithme systématique pour calculer une racine carrée manuellement avec une précision infinie. 1. Séparez les chiffres par paires de part et d'autre de la virgule 2. Trouvez le plus grand entier dont le carré est inférieur ou égal à la première tranche 3. Soustrayez, abaissez la tranche suivante et doublez la racine provisoire 4. Déterminez le chiffre suivant et répétez le processus Cette méthode manuelle permet d'extraire la racine de tout nombre décimal sans calculatrice. Méthode 4 : Méthode d'Estimation (Calcul Mental Rapide) Pour obtenir rapidement un ordre de grandeur sans outil électronique : Exemple : Estimer √50 1. Repérez les deux carrés parfaits encadrants : 49 < 50 < 64 (donc 7 < √50 < 8) 2. 50 étant très proche de 49, √50 est très légèrement supérieur à 7 3. Estimation : environ 7,07 (valeur exacte : 7,0711...) Cette approche est à la base de la méthode babylonienne (algorithme de Héron / Newton-Raphson). Définition Qu'est-ce qu'un Cube Parfait ? Un cube parfait (ou nombre cubique) est un nombre entier obtenu en multipliant un entier par lui-même trois fois : n = k³ = k × k × k. Par exemple, 27 est un cube parfait car 3 × 3 × 3 = 27. De même, 125 est un cube parfait car 5 × 5 × 5 = 125. En revanche, 50 n'est pas un cube parfait car sa racine cubique est approximativement 3,684, ce qui n'est pas un nombre entier. Le mot cube provient de la géométrie 3D : avec 27 petits cubes unitaires identiques, vous pouvez assembler un cube plein de 3×3×3 avec la même longueur, largeur et hauteur. Avec 50 blocs, vous ne pourrez jamais former un cube parfait sans pièces manquantes ou excédentaires. 3³ = 27 ∛27 = 3 (Integer Root) 5³ = 125 ∛125 = 5 (Integer Root) (-4)³ = -64 ∛(-64) = -4 (Real Root!) Les cubes négatifs existent ! Contrairement aux racines carrées, les racines impaires conservent le signe ! (-3)³ = (-3) × (-3) × (-3) = -27. Les entiers négatifs peuvent donc être de vrais cubes parfaits. Zéro et Un 0 et 1 sont des cubes parfaits immédiats : 0³ = 0 et 1³ = 1. Moins un est également un cube parfait : (-1)³ = -1. Parité conservée Le cube d'un nombre pair est toujours pair (2³=8, 4³=64), et le cube d'un nombre impair est toujours impair (3³=27, 5³=125). Exposants de facteurs premiers En décomposition en facteurs premiers, un entier est un cube parfait si et seulement si l'exposant de chaque facteur premier est un multiple de 3. Démonstrations Mathématiques 4 Tests Prouvés pour Vérifier un Cube Parfait Les mathématiciens utilisent quatre méthodes éprouvées pour déterminer si un nombre est un cube parfait : If √‾N‾ = k ∈ ℤ, then N is a Perfect Cube (k × k × k = N) 1 Test 1 : Racine Cubique Entière Vérification directe par calcul Calculez ∛n. Si le résultat est un entier exact sans reste décimal, n est un cube parfait. ∛343 = 7,0000000 → Entier exact 7 confirmé. 2 Test 2 : Règle des Facteurs Premiers Tous les exposants doivent être multiples de 3 Décomposez n en facteurs premiers. Si chaque exposant est divisible par 3 (3, 6, 9...), alors n est un cube parfait. 216 = 2³ × 3³ (exposants 3 et 3, tous deux divisibles par 3) → Cube parfait ! 3 Test 3 : Cubes Négatifs et Symétrie Les puissances impaires conservent le signe négatif Puisque (-k)³ = -k³, un nombre négatif -n est un cube parfait si et seulement si |n| est un cube parfait. -512 est un cube parfait car 512 = 8³, d'où ∛(-512) = -8. 4 Test 4 : Règle de la Racine Numérique (Mod 9) Filtre d'élimination rapide Additionnez les chiffres de n jusqu'à obtenir un seul chiffre. La racine numérique d'un cube parfait est TOUJOURS 0, 1, 8 ou 9. Si elle vaut 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 ou 7, ce n'est JAMAIS un cube parfait ! Racine numérique de 1331 : 1+3+3+1 = 8 (passe le test avec succès). Digital root: 5 + 1 + 2 = 8 (valid). NOT A CUBE Example 2: Testing 100 ∛100 ≈ 4.642 : 100 sits strictly between 4³ = 64 and 5³ = 125. Prime factors are 2² × 5², neither exponent is divisible by 3. REAL NEGATIVE CUBE Example 3: Testing -216 ∛(-216) = -6 : (-6) × (-6) × (-6) = 36 × (-6) = -216. Odd roots preserve negative signs, producing a valid real integer root. Mental Math Mental Math Shortcuts: The 1-to-1 Last-Digit Bijection Unlike perfect squares (which can only end in 0, 1, 4, 5, 6, or 9), every digit from 0 to 9 can be the last digit of a perfect cube. In fact, there is a strict one-to-one bijection between the ones digit of a base integer and the ones digit of its cube: Base Last Digit (k) Cube Calculation (k³ mod 10) Cube Last Digit (k³) Memory Rule 0 0³ = 0 0 Preserved (Same digit) 1 1³ = 1 1 Preserved (Same digit) 2 2³ = 8 8 Complements to 10 (2 + 8 = 10) 3 3³ = 27 7 Complements to 10 (3 + 7 = 10) 4 4³ = 64 4 Preserved (Same digit) 5 5³ = 125 5 Preserved (Same digit) 6 6³ = 216 6 Preserved (Same digit) 7 7³ = 343 3 Complements to 10 (7 + 3 = 10) 8 8³ = 512 2 Complements to 10 (8 + 2 = 10) 9 9³ = 729 9 Preserved (Same digit) PRO TRICK Extracting Cube Roots of Large Numbers (Up to 1,000,000) in 3 Seconds To find the cube root of 175,616 : 1. Ones Digit: The number ends in 6. Looking at our table, a cube ending in 6 must have a root ending in 6 . 2. Tens Digit: Cross off the last three digits (616), leaving 175 . The largest perfect cube below 175 is 125 (5³). So the tens digit is 5 . Result: ∛175616 = 56 . Verified: 56 × 56 × 56 = 175,616! Special Cases Edge Cases: Zero, Negative Cubes, Fractions, and Decimals Odd powers behave differently from even powers. Here is how special numeric sets are evaluated: 1. Is Zero a Perfect Cube? Yes. 0 is an integer, and 0 × 0 × 0 = 0 (0³ = 0). Its principal cube root is exactly 0. 2. Negative Perfect Cubes Fully Real. Unlike square roots which require the imaginary unit i, odd roots preserve signs: (-k)³ = -k³. For example, ∛(-64) = -4. 3. Rational Fractions A fraction is a cubic power if both its numerator and denominator are perfect cubes: 27/64 = (3/4)³. 4. Finite Decimals Decimals are cubes if the significant digits form a cube and the number of decimal places is a multiple of 3: 0.027 = (0.3)³, 0.000125 = (0.05)³. Mistakes to Avoid Common Mistakes and Misconceptions to Avoid #1 Confusing Cubing with Multiplying by 3 Cubing a number means multiplying it by itself three times (4³ = 4 × 4 × 4 = 64), not multiplying it by three (4 × 3 = 12). #2 Assuming Negative Numbers Cannot Be Cubes Unlike square roots, odd roots preserve negative signs. Multiplying three negative numbers gives a negative product: (-5) × (-5) × (-5) = -125. #3 Trying to Rule Out Cubes by Last Digits Alone Every digit from 0 to 9 can end a perfect cube. You cannot eliminate a candidate by its last digit alone; you must use prime factors or modulo 9 digital roots. #4 Floating-Point Rounding Pitfalls in Calculators In computers, computing 125^(1/3) frequently yields 4.999999999999999. acceptedAnswer.text: Un carré parfait est un nombre entier qui peut s'écrire comme le produit de deux entiers égaux. Par exemple, 36 est un carré parfait car 6 × 6 = 36.

mainEntity.name: Un nombre négatif peut-il être un carré parfait ?

acceptedAnswer.text: Non, en arithmétique réelle, un nombre négatif ne peut pas être un carré parfait car le carré de tout nombre réel est toujours positif ou nul.

mainEntity.name: 0 est-il un carré parfait ?

acceptedAnswer.text: Oui, 0 est un carré parfait car 0 × 0 = 0 (0² = 0).

mainEntity.name: Quelle est la différence entre racine carrée et carré parfait ?

acceptedAnswer.text: Le carré parfait est le résultat (ex. 25), tandis que la racine carrée est le nombre d'origine élevé au carré (ex. 5).

mainEntity.name: Qu'est-ce qu'une racine cubique ?

acceptedAnswer.text: La racine cubique d'un nombre est la valeur qui, multipliée par elle-même trois fois, donne ce nombre d'origine. Notée ∛x ou x^(1/3). Par exemple, la racine cubique de 27 est 3 car 3 × 3 × 3 = 27.

mainEntity.name: Peut-on calculer la racine cubique d'un nombre négatif ?

acceptedAnswer.text: Oui ! Contrairement aux racines carrées, les racines cubiques de nombres négatifs sont des nombres réels, car le produit de trois négatifs est négatif : ∛(-x) = -∛x. Par exemple, ∛(-8) = -2 car (-2) × (-2) × (-2) = -8.

mainEntity.name: Quelle est la différence entre élever au cube et extraire la racine cubique ?

acceptedAnswer.text: Élever au cube et extraire la racine cubique sont des opérations réciproques. Élever 4 au cube donne 4³ = 64. Prendre la racine cubique de 64 redonne le nombre de départ : ∛64 = 4.

mainEntity.name: Qu'est-ce qu'un cube parfait ?

acceptedAnswer.text: Un cube parfait est un nombre entier issu de la multiplication d'un entier trois fois par lui-même (ex. 1, 8, 27, 64, 125, 216, 343, 512, 729, 1000). Sa racine cubique est toujours un nombre entier exact.

mainEntity.name: Comment calculer une racine cubique sans calculatrice ?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pour un cube parfait, décomposez en facteurs premiers et regroupez par triplets (ex. 3375 = 3³ × 5³ = 15). Pour les autres nombres, estimez en encadrant le nombre entre deux cubes parfaits connus.

mainEntity.name: Quel est le symbole de la racine cubique ?

acceptedAnswer.text: Le symbole est ∛ (Unicode U+221B). Il s'agit du radical avec un exposant 3 dans le coin supérieur gauche. En code informatique, il s'écrit cbrt(x), et en LaTeX \sqrt[3]{x}.

mainEntity.name: Comment taper le symbole racine cubique (∛) au clavier ?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sous Windows, tapez 221B puis Alt+X, ou utilisez la Table des caractères. Sur Mac, utilisez le visualiseur de caractères (Cmd+Ctrl+Espace). Sur le Web, utilisez l'entité HTML ∛ ou copiez-collez ∛.

mainEntity.name: Combien vaut ∛0 ?

acceptedAnswer.text: La racine cubique de 0 est égale à 0, car 0 × 0 × 0 = 0.

mainEntity.name: La racine cubique de 2 est-elle rationnelle ou irrationnelle ?

acceptedAnswer.text: La racine cubique de 2 (∛2 ≈ 1,2599) est un nombre irrationnel. Elle ne peut pas être exprimée sous forme d'une fraction simple et ses décimales se poursuivent à l'infini sans répétition.

mainEntity.name: Combien vaut ∛1 ?

acceptedAnswer.text: La racine cubique réelle de 1 est 1, car 1 × 1 × 1 = 1.

FAQ Foire Aux Questions Qu'est-ce qu'une racine cubique ? La racine cubique d'un nombre est la valeur qui, multipliée par elle-même trois fois, donne ce nombre d'origine. Notée ∛x ou x^(1/3). Par exemple, la racine cubique de 27 est 3 car 3 × 3 × 3 = 27. Peut-on calculer la racine cubique d'un nombre négatif ? Oui ! Contrairement aux racines carrées, les racines cubiques de nombres négatifs sont des nombres réels, car le produit de trois négatifs est négatif : ∛(-x) = -∛x. Par exemple, ∛(-8) = -2 car (-2) × (-2) × (-2) = -8. Quelle est la différence entre élever au cube et extraire la racine cubique ? Élever au cube et extraire la racine cubique sont des opérations réciproques. Élever 4 au cube donne 4³ = 64. Prendre la racine cubique de 64 redonne le nombre de départ : ∛64 = 4. Qu'est-ce qu'un cube parfait ? Un cube parfait est un nombre entier issu de la multiplication d'un entier trois fois par lui-même (ex. 1, 8, 27, 64, 125, 216, 343, 512, 729, 1000). Sa racine cubique est toujours un nombre entier exact. Comment calculer une racine cubique sans calculatrice ? Pour un cube parfait, décomposez en facteurs premiers et regroupez par triplets (ex. 3375 = 3³ × 5³ = 15). Pour les autres nombres, estimez en encadrant le nombre entre deux cubes parfaits connus. Quel est le symbole de la racine cubique ? Le symbole est ∛ (Unicode U+221B). Il s'agit du radical avec un exposant 3 dans le coin supérieur gauche. En code informatique, il s'écrit cbrt(x), et en LaTeX \sqrt[3]{x}. Comment taper le symbole racine cubique (∛) au clavier ? Sous Windows, tapez 221B puis Alt+X, ou utilisez la Table des caractères. Sur Mac, utilisez le visualiseur de caractères (Cmd+Ctrl+Espace). Sur le Web, utilisez l'entité HTML ∛ ou copiez-collez ∛. Combien vaut ∛0 ? La racine cubique de 0 est égale à 0, car 0 × 0 × 0 = 0. La racine cubique de 2 est-elle rationnelle ou irrationnelle ? La racine cubique de 2 (∛2 ≈ 1,2599) est un nombre irrationnel. Elle ne peut pas être exprimée sous forme d'une fraction simple et ses décimales se poursuivent à l'infini sans répétition. Combien vaut ∛1 ? La racine cubique réelle de 1 est 1, car 1 × 1 × 1 = 1. 4i)। वर्गमूल और घनमूल में क्या अंतर है? वर्गमूल 2 बार गुणा होने वाली संख्या है (घात 2) और घनमूल 3 बार (घात 3)। बिना कैलकुलेटर के वर्गमूल कैसे निकालें? अभाज्य गुणनखंडन, भाग विधि या सन्निकटन विधि द्वारा। पूर्ण वर्ग संख्या क्या है? वह पूर्णांक जिसका वर्गमूल भी पूर्णांक हो (1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, 100)। क्या सभी वर्गमूल परिमेय संख्याएँ हैं? नहीं, केवल पूर्ण वर्ग परिमेय होते हैं। शेष सभी अपरिमेय संख्याएँ हैं। क्या यह कैलकुलेटर पूर्णतः मुफ्त है? हाँ, यह 100% मुफ्त, असीमित और बिना किसी पंजीकरण के उपलब्ध है। क्या भिन्नों का वर्गमूल निकाला जा सकता है? हाँ, आप दशमलव और भिन्न संख्याएं दर्ज कर सकते हैं। मुख्य वर्गमूल क्या है? प्रतीक √ द्वारा दर्शाया जाने वाला धनात्मक (अऋणात्मक) मान मुख्य वर्गमूल कहलाता है। द्वारा लिखित और सत्यापित Syed Muhammad Ahmed संस्थापक और निर्माता साझा करें: The largest perfect cube below 175 is 125 (5³). So the tens digit is 5 . Result: ∛175616 = 56 . Verified: 56 × 56 × 56 = 175,616! Unlike square roots which require the imaginary unit i, odd roots preserve signs: (-k)³ = -k³. For example, ∛(-64) = -4. 3. Finite Decimals Decimals are cubes if the significant digits form a cube and the number of decimal places is a multiple of 3: 0.027 = (0.3)³, 0.000125 = (0.05)³. Mistakes to Avoid Common Mistakes and Misconceptions to Avoid #1 Confusing Cubing with Multiplying by 3 Cubing a number means multiplying it by itself three times (4³ = 4 × 4 × 4 = 64), not multiplying it by three (4 × 3 = 12). #2 Assuming Negative Numbers Cannot Be Cubes Unlike square roots, odd roots preserve negative signs. mainEntity.name: What is a cube root?

acceptedAnswer.text: A cube root of a number is a value that, when multiplied by itself three times, produces the original number. In mathematical notation, the cube root of x is written as ∛x or x^(1/3). For example, the cube root of 27 is 3, because 3 × 3 × 3 = 27.

mainEntity.name: Can you take the cube root of a negative number?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Unlike square roots, cube roots of negative numbers are real numbers because multiplying three negative numbers results in a negative product. The rule is ∛(-x) = -∛x. For example, ∛(-8) = -2, because (-2) × (-2) × (-2) = -8.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between cubing and taking a cube root?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cubing and taking the cube root are inverse operations. Cubing a number means raising it to the power of 3 (for example, 4³ = 64). Taking the cube root reverses this process to recover the original base value: ∛64 = 4.

mainEntity.name: What is a perfect cube?

acceptedAnswer.text: A perfect cube is an integer that results from multiplying an integer by itself three times. Examples include 1, 8, 27, 64, 125, 216, 343, 512, 729, and 1000. The cube root of a perfect cube is always a whole number.

mainEntity.name: How do you calculate a cube root without a calculator?

acceptedAnswer.text: For perfect cubes, use prime factorization: break the number into prime factors, group identical factors into sets of three, and extract one from each group (e.g. 3375 = 3³ × 5³ = 15). For non-perfect cubes, use estimation between the two nearest known perfect cubes.

mainEntity.name: What is the cube root symbol?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cube root symbol is ∛ (Unicode character U+221B). It consists of a standard radical sign with a small index 3 in the upper-left notch. In software code it is written cbrt(x), and in LaTeX as \sqrt[3]{x}.

mainEntity.name: How do you type the cube root symbol?

acceptedAnswer.text: On Windows, type 221B then press Alt+X in supported apps, or use Character Map. On Mac, press Cmd+Ctrl+Space to open Character Viewer and search 'cube root'. In HTML, use the entity ∛ or copy and paste ∛ directly.

mainEntity.name: What is ∛0?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cube root of 0 is exactly 0, because 0 × 0 × 0 = 0.

mainEntity.name: Is the cube root of 2 rational or irrational?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cube root of 2 (∛2 ≈ 1.2599) is an irrational number. It cannot be expressed as an exact fraction of two integers, and its decimal expansion continues infinitely without repeating.

mainEntity.name: What is the cube root of 1?

acceptedAnswer.text: The real cube root of 1 is 1, since 1 × 1 × 1 = 1. (In complex mathematics, there are also two non-real complex cube roots of unity: e^(2πi/3) and e^(-2πi/3)).

A cube root of a number is a value that, when multiplied by itself three times, produces the original number. In mathematical notation, the cube root of x is written as ∛x or x^(1/3). For example, the cube root of 27 is 3, because 3 × 3 × 3 = 27. Can you take the cube root of a negative number? Yes! Unlike square roots, cube roots of negative numbers are real numbers because multiplying three negative numbers results in a negative product. The rule is ∛(-x) = -∛x. For example, ∛(-8) = -2, because (-2) × (-2) × (-2) = -8. What is the difference between cubing and taking a cube root? Cubing and taking the cube root are inverse operations. Cubing a number means raising it to the power of 3 (for example, 4³ = 64). Taking the cube root reverses this process to recover the original base value: ∛64 = 4. What is a perfect cube? A perfect cube is an integer that results from multiplying an integer by itself three times. Examples include 1, 8, 27, 64, 125, 216, 343, 512, 729, and 1000. The cube root of a perfect cube is always a whole number. How do you calculate a cube root without a calculator? For perfect cubes, use prime factorization: break the number into prime factors, group identical factors into sets of three, and extract one from each group (e.g. 3375 = 3³ × 5³ = 15). For non-perfect cubes, use estimation between the two nearest known perfect cubes. What is the cube root symbol? The cube root symbol is ∛ (Unicode character U+221B). It consists of a standard radical sign with a small index 3 in the upper-left notch. In software code it is written cbrt(x), and in LaTeX as \sqrt[3]{x}. How do you type the cube root symbol? On Windows, type 221B then press Alt+X in supported apps, or use Character Map. On Mac, press Cmd+Ctrl+Space to open Character Viewer and search 'cube root'. In HTML, use the entity ∛ or copy and paste ∛ directly. What is ∛0? The cube root of 0 is exactly 0, because 0 × 0 × 0 = 0. Is the cube root of 2 rational or irrational? The cube root of 2 (∛2 ≈ 1.2599) is an irrational number. It cannot be expressed as an exact fraction of two integers, and its decimal expansion continues infinitely without repeating. What is the cube root of 1? The real cube root of 1 is 1, since 1 × 1 × 1 = 1. (In complex mathematics, there are also two non-real complex cube roots of unity: e^(2πi/3) and e^(-2πi/3)). द्वारा लिखित और सत्यापित Syed Muhammad Ahmed Founder & Creator साझा करें:: निष्कर्ष निष्कर्ष और सारांश मुख्य बिंदु घनमूल घन करने (x³) की विपरीत प्रक्रिया है और यह सभी धनात्मक व ऋणात्मक वास्तविक संख्याओं के लिए मान्य है।

Principal Square Root: While every positive number has two roots, the radical symbol specifically denotes the positive value (+7). Inverse of Squaring: Finding a square root is the direct inverse mathematical operation of squaring a number (n²). Excel & Sheets How to Generate a Square Root Table in Spreadsheets (Excel & Google Sheets) 1 Populate Numbers in Column A Type 1 in cell A2 and 2 in cell A3, then drag the fill handle down to row 101. 2 Enter the Square Root Formula In cell B2, enter the formula below and double-click the fill handle: =SQRT(A2) Copy 3 Add Automated Perfect Square Labels In cell C2, enter this logical formula to label perfect squares automatically: =IF(SQRT(A2)=INT(SQRT(A2)), "Perfect Square", "Irrational") Copy Generating square root charts in Excel and Google Sheets using the SQRT formula. तुलना चार्ट बनाम कैलकुलेटर: क्या अंतर है? कैलकुलेटर एक समय में एक संख्या को हल करता है; चार्ट एक पूरी सीमा का त्वरित अवलोकन प्रदान करता है। कैलकुलेटर चरण-दर-चरण गुणनखंड के साथ अलग-अलग संख्याओं को हल करता है। तालिका जनरेटर त्वरित तुलना और प्रिंटिंग के लिए संपूर्ण संख्या अंतराल प्रदर्शित करता है। विस्तृत चरणों के लिए कैलकुलेटर का उपयोग करें और व्यापक संदर्भ के लिए इस तालिका जनरेटर का। उपयोग सुझाव चार्ट पढ़ने के व्यावहारिक सुझाव तालिका के परिणामों का विश्लेषण करने की व्यावहारिक तकनीकें: पहले पूर्ण वर्ग खोजें 1, 4, 9, 16 आदि अन्य मूलों का अनुमान लगाने में मदद करते हैं। प्रकार स्तंभ देखें पूर्ण मूलों और दशमलव अनुमानों में तुरंत अंतर करें। सटीकता समायोजित करें स्कूल के लिए 2 दशमलव और विज्ञान/इंजीनियरिंग के लिए 4 दशमलव चुनें। ISO 80000-1 International Mathematical Conventions: US, UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, and France US, UK, Canada & Australia Uses a period (.) as the decimal separator (for example, √2 ≈ 1.414). mainEntity.name: What is a cube root?

acceptedAnswer.text: A cube root of a number is a value that, when multiplied by itself three times, produces the original number. In mathematical notation, the cube root of x is written as ∛x or x^(1/3). For example, the cube root of 27 is 3, because 3 × 3 × 3 = 27.

mainEntity.name: Can you take the cube root of a negative number?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Unlike square roots, cube roots of negative numbers are real numbers because multiplying three negative numbers results in a negative product. The rule is ∛(-x) = -∛x. For example, ∛(-8) = -2, because (-2) × (-2) × (-2) = -8.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between cubing and taking a cube root?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cubing and taking the cube root are inverse operations. Cubing a number means raising it to the power of 3 (for example, 4³ = 64). Taking the cube root reverses this process to recover the original base value: ∛64 = 4.

mainEntity.name: What is a perfect cube?

acceptedAnswer.text: A perfect cube is an integer that results from multiplying an integer by itself three times. Examples include 1, 8, 27, 64, 125, 216, 343, 512, 729, and 1000. The cube root of a perfect cube is always a whole number.

mainEntity.name: How do you calculate a cube root without a calculator?

acceptedAnswer.text: For perfect cubes, use prime factorization: break the number into prime factors, group identical factors into sets of three, and extract one from each group (e.g. 3375 = 3³ × 5³ = 15). For non-perfect cubes, use estimation between the two nearest known perfect cubes.

mainEntity.name: What is the cube root symbol?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cube root symbol is ∛ (Unicode character U+221B). It consists of a standard radical sign with a small index 3 in the upper-left notch. In software code it is written cbrt(x), and in LaTeX as \sqrt[3]{x}.

mainEntity.name: How do you type the cube root symbol?

acceptedAnswer.text: On Windows, type 221B then press Alt+X in supported apps, or use Character Map. On Mac, press Cmd+Ctrl+Space to open Character Viewer and search 'cube root'. In HTML, use the entity ∛ or copy and paste ∛ directly.

mainEntity.name: What is ∛0?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cube root of 0 is exactly 0, because 0 × 0 × 0 = 0.

mainEntity.name: Is the cube root of 2 rational or irrational?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cube root of 2 (∛2 ≈ 1.2599) is an irrational number. It cannot be expressed as an exact fraction of two integers, and its decimal expansion continues infinitely without repeating.

mainEntity.name: What is the cube root of 1?

acceptedAnswer.text: The real cube root of 1 is 1, since 1 × 1 × 1 = 1. (In complex mathematics, there are also two non-real complex cube roots of unity: e^(2πi/3) and e^(-2πi/3)).

mainEntity.name: Tutte le radici sono numeri razionali?

È uno dei concetti matematici più cercati al mondo da studenti e professionisti. La radice quadrata di un numero è quel valore che, moltiplicato per se stesso, restituisce il numero di partenza. Se moltiplichi 7 per 7 ottieni 49, quindi la radice quadrata di 49 è 7. È l'operazione inversa dell'elevamento al quadrato. In termini algebrici, la radice quadrata di x è un numero y tale che y × y = x (o y² = x). Tutto qui. Non devi memorizzare formule a memoria: lo strumento fa tutto il lavoro per te. Notazione ed Esponenti Notazione della Radice Quadrata: Il Simbolo √ e x^(1/2) Il simbolo √ è il radicale standard. √36 significa trovare quale numero moltiplicato per se stesso dia 36. Il risultato è 6. √ Simbolo radicale dell'operazione 36 Radicando sotto il simbolo 6 Radice principale positiva Ogni espressione radicale è composta dal simbolo (√), dal radicando e dalla radice. È possibile scrivere la radice quadrata anche sotto forma di esponente frazionario: Forma Radicale (√x) Forma Esponente (x^½) Codice / Sintassi √x = y  ⟺  y² = x Standard mathematical radical sign x^(1/2) = √x  ⟺  49^(1/2) = 7 Fractional power notation used in advanced algebra Math.sqrt(x) /* JavaScript */  |  x ** 0.5 /* Python */ Syntax used in programming and scientific calculators Entrambe le forme hanno identico significato. I calcolatori utilizzano comunemente x^(1/2). Rappresentazione equivalente tra simbolo radicale √ ed esponente frazionario x^(1/2) Formula Base Qual è la Formula della Radice Quadrata? Non esiste una singola formula chiusa come per l'area di una figura geometrica. La radice quadrata è definita da una relazione inversa: If y = √x, then y × y = x  (or y² = x) In parole semplici: qualunque sia la radice ottenuta, moltiplicandola per se stessa si deve riottenere esattamente il numero iniziale. Convenzione della Radice Quadrata Principale La radice principale è sempre il valore non negativo. Sia 5 che -5 al quadrato fanno 25, ma per convenzione √25 = 5. Principal Root √25 = +5 Dual Algebraic Solutions x² = 25 ⇒ x = ±5 Proprietà dei Radicali Le Cinque Proprietà Fondamentali delle Radici Quadrate Queste regole permettono di semplificare e manipolare agevolmente i radicali: 1 1. Regola del Prodotto √(a × b) = √a × √b (per a ≥ 0, b ≥ 0) √(a × b) = √a × √b Esempio: √(4 × 9) = √4 × √9 = 2 × 3 = 6. Diretto: √36 = 6. Permette di scomporre una radice in fattori per semplificarla (es. √72 = 6√2). 2 2. Regola del Quoziente √(a / b) = √a / √b (per a ≥ 0, b > 0) √(a ÷ b) = √a ÷ √b Esempio: √(16/4) = √16 / √4 = 4 / 2 = 2. Diretto: √4 = 2. Consente di calcolare la radice di una frazione separando numeratore e denominatore. 3 3. Regola della Potenza √(a²) = |a| (valore assoluto di a) √(a²) = |a| Esempio: √(7²) = √49 = 7. Quadrato e radice si annullano. Elevare al quadrato e poi estrarre la radice restituisce il valore assoluto iniziale. 4 4. Auto-Moltiplicazione √a × √a = a √a × √a = a Esempio: √13 × √13 = 13. √5 × √5 = 5. Moltiplicare una radice per se stessa elimina il radicale. Utile per razionalizzare i denominatori (1/√5 = √5/5). 5 5. Radice di Radice √(√a) = a^(1/4) (radice quarta) √(√a) = a^(1/4) Esempio: √(√16) = √4 = 2. E 16^(1/4) = 2. Estrarre la radice di una radice equivale alla radice quarta. Raggruppa i fattori uguali a coppie 3. Porta fuori dalla radice un fattore per coppia 4. Moltiplica tra loro i fattori esterni √144 → 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 → (2×2) × (2×2) × (3×3) → 2 × 2 × 3 = 12 √72 → 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 → 6 stays outside, 2 stays inside → 6√2 (≈8.485) Metodo 3: Algoritmo Tradizionale a Mano Metodo manuale simile alla divisione per calcolare la radice con precisione decimale arbitraria. 1. Raggruppa le cifre a coppie partendo dalla virgola 2. Trova il più grande quadrato contenuto nel primo gruppo 3. Sottrai, abbassa la coppia successiva e raddoppia la radice parziale 4. Determina la cifra successiva per tentativi Metodo classico insegnato a scuola per risolvere radici a mano senza calcolatrice. Metodo 4: Stima a Mente (Approssimazione Rapida) Per ottenere un valore indicativo rapidamente a mente: Esempio: Stimare √50 1. Trova i quadrati perfetti adiacenti: 49 < 50 < 64 (quindi 7 < √50 < 8) 2. Essendo 50 molto vicino a 49, √50 è poco più di 7 3. Stima: circa 7,07 (valore reale: 7,0711...) Questo principio è alla base del metodo babilonese (iterazione di Newton-Raphson). Un numero intero la cui radice quadrata è un numero intero esatto (es. 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, 100). Tutte le radici sono numeri razionali? No. Solo i quadrati perfetti danno radici razionali. Tutti gli altri generano numeri irrazionali con decimali infiniti. La calcolatrice è gratuita? Risponde alla domanda: quale valore, moltiplicato per se stesso n volte, produce questo numero? Esploratore anatomico interattivo Fai clic su un elemento per scoprire il ruolo matematico ⁴ √ 81 = 3 1. Indice della radice (Grado n) Il piccolo numero in alto a sinistra del segno di radice. Indica quanti fattori identici moltiplicare. Se omesso, vale 2 (radice quadrata). 2. Segno di radice e vincolo L'operatore matematico (√). La barra orizzontale superiore (vincolo) raggruppa il radicando sottostante. 3. Radicando (x) Il valore sotto il radicale. Con indice n pari, deve essere non negativo (x ≥ 0) per avere soluzioni reali. 4. Radice principale (y) Il risultato reale positivo. Per ⁴√81, la radice principale è 3 poiché 3⁴ = 81. Esempio: La radice quarta di 16 è 2, perché 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 = 16. Tutte le radici condividono lo stesso principio matematico. La radice ennesima è definita formalmente come l'inverso dell'elevamento a potenza: ⁿ√x = x^(1/n) Se y = ⁿ√x, allora yⁿ = x. mainEntity.name: Cos'è un cubo perfetto in parole semplici?

acceptedAnswer.text: È un numero intero che deriva dal moltiplicare un intero per se stesso tre volte. Ad esempio, 27 è un cubo perfetto perché 3 × 3 × 3 = 27.

mainEntity.name: Un numero negativo può essere un cubo perfetto?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sì! Il prodotto di tre numeri negativi è negativo: (-4) × (-4) × (-4) = -64. Dunque -64 è un cubo perfetto con radice -4.

mainEntity.name: Lo 0 è un cubo perfetto?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sì, 0 è un cubo perfetto perché 0 × 0 × 0 = 0 (0³ = 0).

mainEntity.name: Un numero può essere sia quadrato che cubo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sì, se gli esponenti primi sono multipli di 6: 1, 64 (8² e 4³), 729 (27² e 9³) e 4096 (64² e 16³).

Cos'è un Cubo Perfetto? Cos'è un Cubo Perfetto? Un cubo perfetto è un numero intero ottenuto moltiplicando un intero per se stesso due volte: n = k × k × k = k³. Il numero k è chiamato radice cubica di n (indicato con ∛n). Ad esempio, 27 è un cubo perfetto perché 3 × 3 × 3 = 27 (quindi ∛27 = 3). Allo stesso modo, 125 = 5³ e -64 = (-4)³. Tuttavia, 50 non è un cubo perfetto poiché ∛50 ≈ 3,684. Il termine deriva dalla geometria 3D: con 27 cubi unitari puoi costruire un cubo solido di 3×3×3 senza spazi vuoti né avanzi. 3³ = 27 ∛27 = 3 (Integer Root) 5³ = 125 ∛125 = 5 (Integer Root) (-4)³ = -64 ∛(-64) = -4 (Real Root!) I cubi negativi esistono! Le potenze dispari mantengono il segno: (-3)³ = -27. Gli interi negativi possono essere veri cubi perfetti reali. Zero e Uno 0 e 1 sono cubi perfetti fondamentali: 0³ = 0 e 1³ = 1. Anche -1 è un cubo: (-1)³ = -1. Coerenza di parità Il cubo di un numero pari è sempre pari (2³=8, 4³=64) e quello di un dispari è sempre dispari (3³=27, 5³=125). Regola degli esponenti primi Nella scomposizione in fattori primi, ogni esponente deve essere un multiplo esatto di 3. 3D Geometric Proof: 27 unit blocks assemble into a complete 3×3×3 cube, while 50 blocks leave incomplete layers and broken voids. 4 Test per Verificare Qualsiasi Cubo Perfetto 4 Test per Verificare Qualsiasi Cubo Perfetto I matematici applicano quattro verifiche fondamentali per confermare un cubo perfetto: If √‾N‾ = k ∈ ℤ, then N is a Perfect Cube (k × k × k = N) 1 Test 1: Radice cubica intera Calcolo diretto Calcola ∛n. Se la radice non ha cifre decimali, n è un cubo perfetto. ∛343 = 7,0000000 → Intero esatto 7. 2 Test 2: Fattori primi Esponenti divisibili per 3 Scomponi in fattori primi. Se ogni esponente è divisibile per 3, è un cubo. 216 = 2³ × 3³ → Cubo perfetto! 3 Test 3: Simmetria negativa Regola delle potenze dispari Dato che (-k)³ = -k³, un numero negativo -n è un cubo se |n| lo è. -512 è un cubo perfetto perché ∛(-512) = -8. 4 Test 4: Radice numerica (Mod 9) Filtro di esclusione Sommando ripetutamente le cifre, la radice numerica di un cubo è sempre 0, 1, 8 o 9. Radice numerica di 1331: 1+3+3+1 = 8 (test superato). Step-by-Step Proofs Step-by-Step Worked Verification Examples PERFECT CUBE Example 1: Testing 512 ∛512 = 8 : 8 × 8 × 8 = 512. Prime factorization is 2⁹ with exponent 9 divisible by 3. Digital root: 5 + 1 + 2 = 8 (valid). NOT A CUBE Example 2: Testing 100 ∛100 ≈ 4.642 : 100 sits strictly between 4³ = 64 and 5³ = 125. Prime factors are 2² × 5², neither exponent is divisible by 3. REAL NEGATIVE CUBE Example 3: Testing -216 ∛(-216) = -6 : (-6) × (-6) × (-6) = 36 × (-6) = -216. Odd roots preserve negative signs, producing a valid real integer root. Mental Math Mental Math Shortcuts: The 1-to-1 Last-Digit Bijection Unlike perfect squares (which can only end in 0, 1, 4, 5, 6, or 9), every digit from 0 to 9 can be the last digit of a perfect cube. In fact, there is a strict one-to-one bijection between the ones digit of a base integer and the ones digit of its cube: Base Last Digit (k) Cube Calculation (k³ mod 10) Cube Last Digit (k³) Memory Rule 0 0³ = 0 0 Preserved (Same digit) 1 1³ = 1 1 Preserved (Same digit) 2 2³ = 8 8 Complements to 10 (2 + 8 = 10) 3 3³ = 27 7 Complements to 10 (3 + 7 = 10) 4 4³ = 64 4 Preserved (Same digit) 5 5³ = 125 5 Preserved (Same digit) 6 6³ = 216 6 Preserved (Same digit) 7 7³ = 343 3 Complements to 10 (7 + 3 = 10) 8 8³ = 512 2 Complements to 10 (8 + 2 = 10) 9 9³ = 729 9 Preserved (Same digit) PRO TRICK Extracting Cube Roots of Large Numbers (Up to 1,000,000) in 3 Seconds To find the cube root of 175,616 : 1. Ones Digit: The number ends in 6. Looking at our table, a cube ending in 6 must have a root ending in 6 . 2. Tens Digit: Cross off the last three digits (616), leaving 175 . The largest perfect cube below 175 is 125 (5³). So the tens digit is 5 . Result: ∛175616 = 56 . Verified: 56 × 56 × 56 = 175,616! Mental Math Secret: The 1-to-1 last-digit bijection between base roots and cube endings, and how to extract 6-digit roots in seconds. Special Cases Edge Cases: Zero, Negative Cubes, Fractions, and Decimals Odd powers behave differently from even powers. Here is how special numeric sets are evaluated: 1. Is Zero a Perfect Cube? Yes. 0 is an integer, and 0 × 0 × 0 = 0 (0³ = 0). Its principal cube root is exactly 0. 2. Negative Perfect Cubes Fully Real. Unlike square roots which require the imaginary unit i, odd roots preserve signs: (-k)³ = -k³. For example, ∛(-64) = -4. 3. Rational Fractions A fraction is a cubic power if both its numerator and denominator are perfect cubes: 27/64 = (3/4)³. 4. Finite Decimals Decimals are cubes if the significant digits form a cube and the number of decimal places is a multiple of 3: 0.027 = (0.3)³, 0.000125 = (0.05)³. mainEntity.name: Cos'è un quadrato perfetto in parole semplici?

acceptedAnswer.text: Un quadrato perfetto è un numero intero ottenuto moltiplicando un intero per se stesso. Ad esempio, 36 è un quadrato perfetto perché 6 × 6 = 36.

mainEntity.name: Un numero negativo può essere un quadrato perfetto?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, nei numeri reali nessun numero negativo può essere un quadrato perfetto poiché il quadrato di qualsiasi reale è sempre zero o positivo.

mainEntity.name: Lo 0 è un quadrato perfetto?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sì, 0 è un quadrato perfetto perché 0 × 0 = 0 (0² = 0).

mainEntity.name: Qual è la differenza tra radice quadrata e quadrato perfetto?

acceptedAnswer.text: Il quadrato perfetto è il risultato moltiplicato (es. 25), mentre la radice quadrata è il numero originario di base (es. 5).

mainEntity.name: What is a cube root?

acceptedAnswer.text: A cube root of a number is a value that, when multiplied by itself three times, produces the original number. In mathematical notation, the cube root of x is written as ∛x or x^(1/3). For example, the cube root of 27 is 3, because 3 × 3 × 3 = 27.

mainEntity.name: Can you take the cube root of a negative number?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Unlike square roots, cube roots of negative numbers are real numbers because multiplying three negative numbers results in a negative product. The rule is ∛(-x) = -∛x. For example, ∛(-8) = -2, because (-2) × (-2) × (-2) = -8.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between cubing and taking a cube root?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cubing and taking the cube root are inverse operations. Cubing a number means raising it to the power of 3 (for example, 4³ = 64). Taking the cube root reverses this process to recover the original base value: ∛64 = 4.

mainEntity.name: What is a perfect cube?

acceptedAnswer.text: A perfect cube is an integer that results from multiplying an integer by itself three times. Examples include 1, 8, 27, 64, 125, 216, 343, 512, 729, and 1000. The cube root of a perfect cube is always a whole number.

mainEntity.name: How do you calculate a cube root without a calculator?

acceptedAnswer.text: For perfect cubes, use prime factorization: break the number into prime factors, group identical factors into sets of three, and extract one from each group (e.g. 3375 = 3³ × 5³ = 15). For non-perfect cubes, use estimation between the two nearest known perfect cubes.

mainEntity.name: What is the cube root symbol?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cube root symbol is ∛ (Unicode character U+221B). It consists of a standard radical sign with a small index 3 in the upper-left notch. In software code it is written cbrt(x), and in LaTeX as \sqrt[3]{x}.

mainEntity.name: How do you type the cube root symbol?

acceptedAnswer.text: On Windows, type 221B then press Alt+X in supported apps, or use Character Map. On Mac, press Cmd+Ctrl+Space to open Character Viewer and search 'cube root'. In HTML, use the entity ∛ or copy and paste ∛ directly.

mainEntity.name: What is ∛0?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cube root of 0 is exactly 0, because 0 × 0 × 0 = 0.

mainEntity.name: Is the cube root of 2 rational or irrational?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cube root of 2 (∛2 ≈ 1.2599) is an irrational number. It cannot be expressed as an exact fraction of two integers, and its decimal expansion continues infinitely without repeating.

mainEntity.name: What is the cube root of 1?

acceptedAnswer.text: The real cube root of 1 is 1, since 1 × 1 × 1 = 1. (In complex mathematics, there are also two non-real complex cube roots of unity: e^(2πi/3) and e^(-2πi/3)).

FAQ Domande Frequenti What is a cube root? A cube root of a number is a value that, when multiplied by itself three times, produces the original number. In mathematical notation, the cube root of x is written as ∛x or x^(1/3). For example, the cube root of 27 is 3, because 3 × 3 × 3 = 27. Can you take the cube root of a negative number? Yes! Unlike square roots, cube roots of negative numbers are real numbers because multiplying three negative numbers results in a negative product. The rule is ∛(-x) = -∛x. For example, ∛(-8) = -2, because (-2) × (-2) × (-2) = -8. What is the difference between cubing and taking a cube root? Cubing and taking the cube root are inverse operations. Cubing a number means raising it to the power of 3 (for example, 4³ = 64). Taking the cube root reverses this process to recover the original base value: ∛64 = 4. What is a perfect cube? A perfect cube is an integer that results from multiplying an integer by itself three times. Examples include 1, 8, 27, 64, 125, 216, 343, 512, 729, and 1000. The cube root of a perfect cube is always a whole number. How do you calculate a cube root without a calculator? For perfect cubes, use prime factorization: break the number into prime factors, group identical factors into sets of three, and extract one from each group (e.g. 3375 = 3³ × 5³ = 15). For non-perfect cubes, use estimation between the two nearest known perfect cubes. What is the cube root symbol? The cube root symbol is ∛ (Unicode character U+221B). It consists of a standard radical sign with a small index 3 in the upper-left notch. In software code it is written cbrt(x), and in LaTeX as \sqrt[3]{x}. How do you type the cube root symbol? On Windows, type 221B then press Alt+X in supported apps, or use Character Map. On Mac, press Cmd+Ctrl+Space to open Character Viewer and search 'cube root'. In HTML, use the entity ∛ or copy and paste ∛ directly. What is ∛0? The cube root of 0 is exactly 0, because 0 × 0 × 0 = 0. Is the cube root of 2 rational or irrational? The cube root of 2 (∛2 ≈ 1.2599) is an irrational number. It cannot be expressed as an exact fraction of two integers, and its decimal expansion continues infinitely without repeating. What is the cube root of 1? The real cube root of 1 is 1, since 1 × 1 × 1 = 1. (In complex mathematics, there are also two non-real complex cube roots of unity: e^(2πi/3) and e^(-2πi/3)). mainEntity.name: 平方根計算機の使い方は？

acceptedAnswer.text: 上の枠に数字を入力して「計算」をクリックするだけです。小数解、簡約形、計算の道筋が瞬時に表示されます。

mainEntity.name: 「racine carrée」とはどういう意味ですか？

acceptedAnswer.text: フランス語で「平方根（スクエアルート）」を意味し、2乗するとその数になる値を指します。

mainEntity.name: 負の数（マイナス）の計算はできますか？

acceptedAnswer.text: はい。虚数単位 i を用いた複素数解（例: √(-16) = 4i）とステップ解説を表示します。

mainEntity.name: 平方根と立方根の違いは？

acceptedAnswer.text: 平方根は2回掛ける数（2乗根）、立方根は3回掛ける数（3乗根）を求めます。

mainEntity.name: 電卓なしで平方根を求めるには？

acceptedAnswer.text: 素因数分解、筆算による開平法、またはバビロニア法による近似計算を用います。

mainEntity.name: 完全平方数とは？
平方根はすべて有理数ですか？

acceptedAnswer.text: いいえ。完全平方数のみが有理数になり、その他の数はすべて無理数です。

mainEntity.name: 利用料金はかかりますか？

acceptedAnswer.text: いいえ。当サイトのツールは完全無料で回数制限もなくご利用いただけます。

mainEntity.name: 分数や小数のルートも計算できますか？

acceptedAnswer.text: はい。小数や分数をそのまま入力して正確に求められます。

mainEntity.name: 主平方根とは何ですか？

acceptedAnswer.text: √ 記号が表す非負（0以上）の解のことを指します。

= 16 であるため √25 = 5 5 × 5 = 25 であるため √100 = 10 10 × 10 = 100 であるため 幾何学的イメージ: 正方形の面積から1辺の長さを求める操作 使い方 平方根計算機の使い方 わずか3ステップで結果が得られます: 1 数値を入力 上の入力欄に計算したい数値（整数、小数、分数、負の数）を入力します。 2 「計算」をクリック は「2乗して36になる数は何か」を表し、答えは6です。 √ 根号（ルート記号） 36 根号の中の数 6 非負の主平方根 平方根の表現は、根号記号・被開数・根（結果）の3要素から成ります。 平方根は分数指数を用いて表すこともできます: 根号形式 (√x) 指数形式 (x^½) コード構文 √x = y  ⟺  y² = x Standard mathematical radical sign x^(1/2) = √x  ⟺  49^(1/2) = 7 Fractional power notation used in advanced algebra Math.sqrt(x) /* JavaScript */  |  x ** 0.5 /* Python */ Syntax used in programming and scientific calculators 両者は数学的に全く同一です。プログラミング言語では通常 x^(1/2) が用いられます。 根号表記 √x と分数指数表記 x^(1/2) の同値関係 基本公式 平方根の定義式 平方根は以下の逆演算関係によって定義されます: If y = √x, then y × y = x  (or y² = x) 得られた数を2回掛け合わせると、必ず元の数値に戻るという性質です。 主平方根の規約 国際的な数学規約により、√ 記号は常に非負（正または0）の「主平方根」を表します。5と-5の双方が2乗で25になりますが、√25 = 5 と定めます。 Principal Root √25 = +5 Dual Algebraic Solutions x² = 25 ⇒ x = ±5 計算規則 平方根の5大基本性質 代数計算や根号の変形で必須となる5つの公式です: 1 1. 積の公式 √(a × b) = √a × √b (a ≥ 0, b ≥ 0) √(a × b) = √a × √b 例: √(4 × 9) = √4 × √9 = 2 × 3 = 6。直接計算: √36 = 6。 数を因数に分解して根号の外に出す際に使います（例: √72 = 6√2）。 2 2. 商の公式 √(a / b) = √a / √b (a ≥ 0, b > 0) √(a ÷ b) = √a ÷ √b 例: √(16/4) = √16 / √4 = 4 / 2 = 2。直接計算: √4 = 2。 分数の分子と分母の平方根を別々に計算できます。 3 3. 累乗の公式 √(a²) = |a| (aの絶対値) √(a²) = |a| 例: √(7²) = √49 = 7。2乗と根号は互いに打ち消し合います。 常に正の絶対値が得られます。 4 4. 同一根の積 √a × √a = a √a × √a = a 例: √13 × √13 = 13。√5 × √5 = 5。 同じ根号同士を掛けると根号が外れます（分母の有理化: 1/√5 = √5/5）。 5 5. 二重根号 √(√a) = a^(1/4) (4乗根) √(√a) = a^(1/4) 例: √(√16) = √4 = 2。16^(1/4) = 2。 根号の根号は元の数の4乗根になります。 計算方法 平方根の求め方: 4つの手法 状況に応じて使い分けられる4種類の手法があります: 1 手法1 2 手法2 3 手法3 4 手法4 手法1: 本オンライン計算機（最速） 数値を入力して「計算」を押すだけで、即座に正確な解と根号の簡約形が得られます。 上部の計算機へ戻る 手法2: 素因数分解法（平方数に最適） 整数や平方数の計算に最適です。 素因数分解の例 1. 数値を素数の積に分解する 2. 同じ素因数を2個ずつのペアにまとめる 3. 各ペアから1個を根号の外に出す 4. 外に出た因数同士を掛け合わせる √144 → 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 → (2×2) × (2×2) × (3×3) → 2 × 2 × 3 = 12 √72 → 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 → 6 stays outside, 2 stays inside → 6√2 (≈8.485) 手法3: 開平法（筆算法） 電卓なしで任意の桁数まで正確に求められる筆算アルゴリズムです。 1. 小数点を基準に2桁ずつ区切る 2. 最初の区切りに入る最大の平方数を見つける 3. 引き算をして次の2桁を下ろし、得られた数を2倍する 4. 試行数字を見つけて手順を繰り返す 紙と鉛筆だけで厳密な小数を求める伝統的手法です。 手法4: 挟み撃ち近似法（暗算向け） 手元に電卓がないときのおおよその暗算に便利です: 例: √50の近似 1. 前後の平方数を探す: 49 < 50 < 64（つまり 7 < √50 < 8） 2. 50は49に極めて近いため、√50は7をわずかに上回る 3. 近似値: 約7.07（厳密値: 7.0711...） バビロニア法（ニュートン法）の基礎となる考え方です。 平方数 平方数（完全平方数）の性質と重要性 平方数とは、平方根が整数になる整数のことです。整数を2乗することで作られます。 √36 = 6 16 256 √256 = 16 7 49 √49 = 7 17 289 √289 = 17 8 64 √64 = 8 18 324 √324 = 18 9 81 √81 = 9 19 361 √361 = 19 10 100 √100 = 10 20 400 √400 = 20 最初の20個の平方数を記憶しておくと、数学の計算スピードが大幅に向上します。

Non-repeating & infinite √3 1.73205080... Non-repeating & infinite √5 2.23606797... Non-repeating & infinite √7 2.64575131... Non-repeating & infinite √10 3.16227766... Non-repeating & infinite 円周率 π と同様に、2つの整数の分数としては表せません。 当計算機では、高精度な小数値と正確な根号簡約形を両方提示します。 小数と分数 小数・分数の平方根 平方根は小数や分数にもそのまま適用できます: 小数の平方根 小数点の位置に注意して計算します: √0.25 = 0.5 (0.5 × 0.5 = 0.25) √0.49 = 0.7 (0.7 × 0.7 = 0.49) √2.25 = 1.5 (1.5 × 1.5 = 2.25) 分数の平方根 商の公式を用いて分子と分母の平方根を個別に求めます: √(1/4) = √1 / √4 = 1/2 √(9/16) = √9 / √16 = 3/4 √(25/49) = √25 / √49 = 5/7 確かめ算には上の計算機をご活用ください。 複素数 負の数の平方根と虚数単位 i 実数の範囲では、実数を2乗すると常に正になるため、負の数の平方根は存在しません。 これに対応するため、数学では虚数単位 i (i² = -1) を定義しています。公式: √(-a) = √a × i (a > 0)。 i = √(−1)  ⟺  i² = −1  ⟺  √(−a) = √a × i 負の数の計算例 √(-1) → i √(-4) → 2i √(-9) → 3i √(-16) → 4i √(-81) → 9i これらは複素数 (a + bi) を構成し、電気工学や量子力学で不可欠です。 当計算機は負の数にも自動対応し、虚数単位 i による解を表示します。

mainEntity.name: 平方根と立方根の違いは何ですか？

acceptedAnswer.text: 平方根は2乗して元の数になる値（次数2）、立方根は3乗して元の数になる値（次数3）です。立方根は負の数に対しても実数解が存在します。

mainEntity.name: n乗根の「次数n」とは何ですか？

acceptedAnswer.text: 根号記号の左上に付く指数 'n'（ⁿ√x）のことです。n=2なら平方根、n=3なら立方根、n=4なら4乗根を表します。

mainEntity.name: 負の数のn乗根は計算できますか？

acceptedAnswer.text: 次数nが奇数（3, 5, 7...）の場合は実数解が存在します。次数nが偶数（2, 4, 6...）の場合は実数解は存在しません。

mainEntity.name: 完全立方数とは簡単に言うと何ですか？

acceptedAnswer.text: ある整数を3回掛け合わせて作られる整数のことです。例えば27は3 × 3 × 3 = 27なので完全立方数です。

mainEntity.name: 負の数も完全立方数になれますか？

acceptedAnswer.text: はい！負の数を3回掛けると負になります：(-4) × (-4) × (-4) = -64。したがって、-64は立法根が-4の完全立方数です。

mainEntity.name: 0は完全立方数ですか？

acceptedAnswer.text: はい、0 × 0 × 0 = 0（0³ = 0）となるため、0も完全立方数です。

mainEntity.name: 平方数と立方数の両方になれる数はありますか？

acceptedAnswer.text: はい、素因数の指数が6の倍数になる数です：1、64（8²かつ4³）、729（27²かつ9³）、4096（64²かつ16³）などがあります。

mainEntity.name: わかりやすく言うと完全平方数とは何ですか？

acceptedAnswer.text: 整数を自分自身で掛け算して得られる整数のことです。例えば、6 × 6 = 36 なので36は完全平方数です。

mainEntity.name: 負の数は完全平方数になれますか？

acceptedAnswer.text: いいえ。実数の世界ではどんな数を2乗しても0以上になるため、負の数が完全平方数になることはありません。

mainEntity.name: 0は完全平方数ですか？

acceptedAnswer.text: はい、0 × 0 = 0（0² = 0）となるため、0も完全平方数です。

mainEntity.name: 平方根と完全平方数の違いは何ですか？

acceptedAnswer.text: 完全平方数は掛け合わせた結果の数値（例：25）であり、平方根はその基となった元の数値（例：5）です。

mainEntity.name: What is a cube root?

acceptedAnswer.text: A cube root of a number is a value that, when multiplied by itself three times, produces the original number. In mathematical notation, the cube root of x is written as ∛x or x^(1/3). For example, the cube root of 27 is 3, because 3 × 3 × 3 = 27.

mainEntity.name: Can you take the cube root of a negative number?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Unlike square roots, cube roots of negative numbers are real numbers because multiplying three negative numbers results in a negative product. The rule is ∛(-x) = -∛x. For example, ∛(-8) = -2, because (-2) × (-2) × (-2) = -8.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between cubing and taking a cube root?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cubing and taking the cube root are inverse operations. Cubing a number means raising it to the power of 3 (for example, 4³ = 64). Taking the cube root reverses this process to recover the original base value: ∛64 = 4.

mainEntity.name: What is a perfect cube?

acceptedAnswer.text: A perfect cube is an integer that results from multiplying an integer by itself three times. Examples include 1, 8, 27, 64, 125, 216, 343, 512, 729, and 1000. The cube root of a perfect cube is always a whole number.

mainEntity.name: How do you calculate a cube root without a calculator?

acceptedAnswer.text: For perfect cubes, use prime factorization: break the number into prime factors, group identical factors into sets of three, and extract one from each group (e.g. 3375 = 3³ × 5³ = 15). For non-perfect cubes, use estimation between the two nearest known perfect cubes.

mainEntity.name: What is the cube root symbol?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cube root symbol is ∛ (Unicode character U+221B). It consists of a standard radical sign with a small index 3 in the upper-left notch. In software code it is written cbrt(x), and in LaTeX as \sqrt[3]{x}.

mainEntity.name: How do you type the cube root symbol?

acceptedAnswer.text: On Windows, type 221B then press Alt+X in supported apps, or use Character Map. On Mac, press Cmd+Ctrl+Space to open Character Viewer and search 'cube root'. In HTML, use the entity ∛ or copy and paste ∛ directly.

mainEntity.name: What is ∛0?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cube root of 0 is exactly 0, because 0 × 0 × 0 = 0.

mainEntity.name: Is the cube root of 2 rational or irrational?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cube root of 2 (∛2 ≈ 1.2599) is an irrational number. It cannot be expressed as an exact fraction of two integers, and its decimal expansion continues infinitely without repeating.

mainEntity.name: What is the cube root of 1?

acceptedAnswer.text: The real cube root of 1 is 1, since 1 × 1 × 1 = 1. (In complex mathematics, there are also two non-real complex cube roots of unity: e^(2πi/3) and e^(-2πi/3)).

Test integers with our instant perfect cube checker → 実社会での応用 科学や実生活における立方根の使われ方 立方根は工学、物理学、天文学など多岐にわたる分野で使われています： 容器やタンクの設計 指定された体積を持つ立方体タンクの一辺の寸法を決定する。 天文学（ケプラーの第3法則） 惑星の公転周期と太陽からの軌道半径の関係を計算する。 材料科学と結晶構造 結晶格子における原子間距離や密度を体積から導く。 生物学のスケーリング法則 生物の体重と体表面積・代謝率の相関関係を解明する。 Real-world application: Calculating container dimensions from volume with cube roots Under the Hood How Does This Cube Root Calculator Work? 1 Client-Side High Performance All calculations execute directly in your browser with zero latency and 100% data privacy. 2 Exact Integer Detection Instantly checks whether the radicand is a perfect cube and outputs exact integers without rounding drift. 3 Radical Simplification Engine Performs prime factorization in real time to extract triple factors, rendering exact forms like ∛24 = 2∛3. 4 Full Real Negative Support Applies the mathematical odd symmetry rule ∛(-x) = -∛x, returning exact real solutions for negative inputs. 5 Arbitrary Precision & Step Workings Provides clean decimal approximations and comprehensive step-by-step mathematical reasoning. よくある質問 立方根に関するFAQ（よくある質問） What is a cube root? A cube root of a number is a value that, when multiplied by itself three times, produces the original number. In mathematical notation, the cube root of x is written as ∛x or x^(1/3). For example, the cube root of 27 is 3, because 3 × 3 × 3 = 27. Can you take the cube root of a negative number? Yes! Unlike square roots, cube roots of negative numbers are real numbers because multiplying three negative numbers results in a negative product. The rule is ∛(-x) = -∛x. For example, ∛(-8) = -2, because (-2) × (-2) × (-2) = -8. What is the difference between cubing and taking a cube root? Cubing and taking the cube root are inverse operations. Cubing a number means raising it to the power of 3 (for example, 4³ = 64). Taking the cube root reverses this process to recover the original base value: ∛64 = 4. What is a perfect cube? A perfect cube is an integer that results from multiplying an integer by itself three times. Examples include 1, 8, 27, 64, 125, 216, 343, 512, 729, and 1000. The cube root of a perfect cube is always a whole number. How do you calculate a cube root without a calculator? For perfect cubes, use prime factorization: break the number into prime factors, group identical factors into sets of three, and extract one from each group (e.g. 3375 = 3³ × 5³ = 15). For non-perfect cubes, use estimation between the two nearest known perfect cubes. What is the cube root symbol? The cube root symbol is ∛ (Unicode character U+221B). It consists of a standard radical sign with a small index 3 in the upper-left notch. In software code it is written cbrt(x), and in LaTeX as \sqrt[3]{x}. How do you type the cube root symbol? On Windows, type 221B then press Alt+X in supported apps, or use Character Map. On Mac, press Cmd+Ctrl+Space to open Character Viewer and search 'cube root'. In HTML, use the entity ∛ or copy and paste ∛ directly. What is ∛0? The cube root of 0 is exactly 0, because 0 × 0 × 0 = 0. Is the cube root of 2 rational or irrational? The cube root of 2 (∛2 ≈ 1.2599) is an irrational number. It cannot be expressed as an exact fraction of two integers, and its decimal expansion continues infinitely without repeating. What is the cube root of 1? The real cube root of 1 is 1, since 1 × 1 × 1 = 1. (In complex mathematics, there are also two non-real complex cube roots of unity: e^(2πi/3) and e^(-2πi/3)). 監修・執筆 Syed Muhammad Ahmed Founder & Creator シェア:: まとめ 結論と重要ポイント 覚えておくべき要点 立方根は3乗の逆演算であり、正の数だけでなく負の数に対しても実数の範囲で常に答えが存在します。

Exploring three-dimensional powers? Solve cube roots and explore cubic reference tables → Geometric concept: The square root represents the side length of a square with a known area. Excel & Sheets How to Generate a Square Root Table in Spreadsheets (Excel & Google Sheets) 1 Populate Numbers in Column A Type 1 in cell A2 and 2 in cell A3, then drag the fill handle down to row 101. 2 Enter the Square Root Formula In cell B2, enter the formula below and double-click the fill handle: =SQRT(A2) Copy 3 Add Automated Perfect Square Labels In cell C2, enter this logical formula to label perfect squares automatically: =IF(SQRT(A2)=INT(SQRT(A2)), "Perfect Square", "Irrational") Copy Generating square root charts in Excel and Google Sheets using the SQRT formula. 比較 早見表と計算機の使い分け 計算機は1つの数値をステップ付きで深く計算し、早見表は広範な数値を一目で比較・確認するのに適しています。 計算機 単一の数値をステップごとの素因数分解とともに詳細に解きます。 表ジェネレーター 印刷や一覧比較に適した連続する数値の範囲全体を生成します。 個別計算の解法確認には計算機を、広範な数値参照には表ジェネレーターをご活用ください。 活用のコツ 早見表の便利な読み方 表を効果的に読み解くための実践テクニック: まず平方数をチェック 1, 4, 9, 16 などの平方数を基準にすると、間の値の予測が簡単になります。 種類の列を活用 きれいに割り切れる整数と近似値の無理数が一目で区別できます。 用途に合わせた桁数設定 学習用には2桁、技術計算や物理には4桁が最適です。 ISO 80000-1 International Mathematical Conventions: US, UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, and France US, UK, Canada & Australia Uses a period (.) as the decimal separator (for example, √2 ≈ 1.414). «Racine carrée»는 제곱근을 뜻하는 프랑스어입니다. 전 세계 학생들이 가장 많이 검색하는 기초 수학 개념 중 하나입니다. 제곱근이란 어떤 수를 자기 자신과 곱했을 때 원래 수가 나오는 값을 말합니다. 7에 7을 곱하면 49가 되므로, 49의 제곱근은 7입니다. 즉, 제곱의 역연산입니다. 수학적으로 x의 제곱근은 y × y = x (또는 y² = x)를 만족하는 수 y를 뜻합니다. 근호 식의 구성 요소 Click or hover over any part √ 49 = 7 √ 근호 기호 (√) 제곱근 추출을 나타내는 수학 기호 49 피제곱근수 (밑수) 근호 아래에 있는 숫자 (예: √49의 49) 7 제곱근 (결과) 계산된 결과값 (예: 7) √4 = 2 2 × 2 = 4 이므로 √9 = 3 3 × 3 = 9 이므로 √16 = 4 4 × 4 = 16 이므로 √25 = 5 5 × 5 = 25 이므로 √100 = 10 10 × 10 = 100 이므로 기하학적 의미: 정사각형의 넓이로부터 한 변의 길이를 구하는 과정 사용 방법 제곱근 계산기 사용법 세 단계만 거치면 정답을 얻을 수 있습니다: 1 숫자 입력 위 입력란에 계산하고 싶은 숫자(정수, 소수, 분수, 음수)를 입력합니다. 2 계산하기 클릭 계산 버튼을 누르면 즉시 고정밀 수학 알고리즘으로 계산됩니다. 3 결과 확인 정확한 소수점 값, 간략화된 근호(예: √72 = 6√2), 풀이 과정이 표시됩니다. 공식을 외우지 않아도 계산기가 모든 과정을 알아서 처리합니다. 기호 및 지수 제곱근 표기법: √ 기호와 x^(1/2) 기호 √는 표준 근호입니다. √36은 '자기 자신과 곱해 36이 되는 수는 무엇인가?'를 묻는 것이며 답은 6입니다. √ 근호 기호 36 근호 안의 수 6 주제곱근 결과 근호 식은 근호 기호, 피제곱근수, 제곱근의 세 부분으로 구성됩니다. 제곱근은 분수 지수 형태로도 표기할 수 있습니다: 근호 형태 (√x) 지수 형태 (x^½) 코드 / 문법 √x = y  ⟺  y² = x Standard mathematical radical sign x^(1/2) = √x  ⟺  49^(1/2) = 7 Fractional power notation used in advanced algebra Math.sqrt(x) /* JavaScript */  |  x ** 0.5 /* Python */ Syntax used in programming and scientific calculators 두 형태는 수학적으로 완전히 동일합니다. 프로그래밍 언어에서는 x^(1/2) 형태를 자주 사용합니다. 근호 표기 √x와 분수 지수 표기 x^(1/2)의 동치 관계 핵심 공식 제곱근의 기본 공식 제곱근은 다음과 같은 역연산 관계로 정의됩니다: If y = √x, then y × y = x  (or y² = x) 구한 값을 자기 자신과 곱했을 때 원래 수가 나와야 한다는 원리입니다. 주제곱근 규칙 국제 수학 규약상 √ 기호는 항상 음이 아닌 양의 '주제곱근'을 의미합니다. 5와 -5 모두 제곱하면 25이지만 √25 = 5로 약속합니다. Principal Root √25 = +5 Dual Algebraic Solutions x² = 25 ⇒ x = ±5 핵심 성질 제곱근의 5가지 핵심 성질 대수 연산과 근호 단순화에 필수적인 법칙들입니다: 1 1. 곱셈 법칙 √(a × b) = √a × √b (a ≥ 0, b ≥ 0) √(a × b) = √a × √b 예: √(4 × 9) = √4 × √9 = 2 × 3 = 6. 직접 계산: √36 = 6. 인수를 분리하여 근호를 간단히 할 수 있습니다 (예: √72 = 6√2). 2 2. 나눗셈 법칙 √(a / b) = √a / √b (a ≥ 0, b > 0) √(a ÷ b) = √a ÷ √b 예: √(16/4) = √16 / √4 = 4 / 2 = 2. 직접 계산: √4 = 2. 분수의 분자와 분모를 각각 분리하여 제곱근을 계산합니다. 3 3. 거듭제곱 법칙 √(a²) = |a| (a의 절댓값) √(a²) = |a| 예: √(7²) = √49 = 7. 제곱과 근호가 상쇄됩니다. 원래 수의 양수 절댓값을 반환합니다. 4 4. 자기 자신과의 곱 √a × √a = a √a × √a = a 예: √13 × √13 = 13. √5 × √5 = 5. 근호를 벗겨낼 때 사용됩니다 (분모의 유리화: 1/√5 = √5/5). 5 5. 이중근호 법칙 √(√a) = a^(1/4) (네제곱근) √(√a) = a^(1/4) 예: √(√16) = √4 = 2. 그리고 16^(1/4) = 2. 제곱근의 제곱근은 네제곱근이 됩니다. 계산 방법 제곱근을 구하는 4가지 방법 상황에 따라 네 가지 계산 방식을 활용할 수 있습니다: 1 방법 1 2 방법 2 3 방법 3 4 방법 4 방법 1: 본 온라인 계산기 활용 (가장 빠름) 숫자를 입력하고 계산을 누르면 즉시 정확한 값과 간략화된 형태가 나옵니다. 계산기로 이동 방법 2: 소인수분해법 (완전제곱수용) 정수와 완전제곱수에 가장 효과적입니다. 소인수분해 예시 1. 숫자를 소인수분해한다 2. 같은 소인수를 둘씩 짝짓는다 3. 각 짝에서 하나씩을 근호 밖으로 꺼낸다 4. 밖으로 꺼낸 숫자들을 서로 곱한다 √144 → 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 → (2×2) × (2×2) × (3×3) → 2 × 2 × 3 = 12 √72 → 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 → 6 stays outside, 2 stays inside → 6√2 (≈8.485) 방법 3: 개평법 (손으로 직접 계산) 계산기 없이 소수점 아래까지 정확히 구하는 전통 필산법입니다. 1. 소수점을 기준으로 두 자리씩 묶는다 2. 첫 묶음에 들어가는 가장 큰 제곱수를 찾는다 3. 빼고 다음 두 자리를 내린 뒤 제곱근을 2배한다 4. 다음 자릿수를 찾아 반복한다 손으로 직접 풀 때 유용한 고전적 방법입니다. 방법 4: 암산 어림셈법 머릿속으로 빠르게 근사값을 추정할 때 유용합니다: 예: √50 어림하기 1. 인접한 완전제곱수 찾기: 49 < 50 < 64 (즉 7 < √50 < 8) 2. 50은 49에 매우 가까우므로 7보다 살짝 큼 3. 어림값: 약 7.07 (실제값: 7.0711...) 바빌로니아 법(헤론 / 뉴턴-랩슨 법)의 기초 원리입니다. 완전제곱수 완전제곱수의 의미와 중요성 완전제곱수는 제곱근이 정수로 딱 떨어지는 정수를 의미합니다. 수 (n) 완전제곱수 (n²) 제곱근 (√n²) 수 (n) 완전제곱수 (n²) 제곱근 (√n²) 1 1 √1 = 1 11 121 √121 = 11 2 4 √4 = 2 12 144 √144 = 12 3 9 √9 = 3 13 169 √169 = 13 4 16 √16 = 4 14 196 √196 = 14 5 25 √25 = 5 15 225 √225 = 15 6 36 √36 = 6 16 256 √256 = 16 7 49 √49 = 7 17 289 √289 = 17 8 64 √64 = 8 18 324 √324 = 18 9 81 √81 = 9 19 361 √361 = 19 10 100 √100 = 10 20 400 √400 = 20 첫 20개의 완전제곱수를 외워두면 암산 능력이 크게 향상됩니다.

완전세제곱수(세제곱수)란 무엇인가요? 완전세제곱수(입방수)는 어떤 정수를 세 번 곱하여 얻은 정수입니다: n = k × k × k = k³. 여기서 k는 n의 세제곱근(∛n)이라고 부릅니다. 예를 들어, 27은 3 × 3 × 3 = 27이므로 완전세제곱수입니다(즉 ∛27 = 3). 마찬가지로 125 = 5³이며, -64 = (-4)³입니다. 반면 50은 ∛50 ≈ 3.684이므로 완전세제곱수가 아닙니다. 이 개념은 3차원 기하학에서 비롯되었습니다. 27개의 단위 정육면체 블록이 있으면 빈틈없이 3×3×3 정육면체를 완성할 수 있습니다. 3³ = 27 ∛27 = 3 (Integer Root) 5³ = 125 ∛125 = 5 (Integer Root) (-4)³ = -64 ∛(-64) = -4 (Real Root!) 음수 세제곱수도 존재합니다! 홀수 거듭제곱은 부호를 보존합니다: (-3)³ = -27. 음의 정수도 엄연한 실수의 완전세제곱수입니다. 0과 1 0과 1은 가장 기본적인 세제곱수입니다: 0³ = 0, 1³ = 1. -1 역시 세제곱수입니다: (-1)³ = -1. 홀짝성 일치 짝수의 세제곱은 항상 짝수(2³=8, 4³=64)이며, 홀수의 세제곱은 항상 홀수(3³=27, 5³=125)입니다. 소인수 지수 법칙 소인수분해했을 때 모든 소인수의 지수가 반드시 3의 배수여야 합니다. 3D Geometric Proof: 27 unit blocks assemble into a complete 3×3×3 cube, while 50 blocks leave incomplete layers and broken voids. 완전세제곱수를 판별하는 4가지 수학적 검증법 완전세제곱수를 판별하는 4가지 수학적 검증법 수학자들은 완전세제곱수를 판별할 때 네 가지 핵심 테스트를 활용합니다: If √‾N‾ = k ∈ ℤ, then N is a Perfect Cube (k × k × k = N) 1 테스트 1: 정수 세제곱근 직접 계산 ∛n을 계산합니다. 소수점 이하가 없는 정수라면 완전세제곱수입니다. ∛343 = 7.0000000 → 정확한 정수 7. 2 테스트 2: 소인수분해 지수가 3의 배수 소인수분해를 수행하여 각 소수의 지수가 모두 3으로 나누어떨어지는지 확인합니다. 216 = 2³ × 3³ → 완전세제곱수! 3 테스트 3: 음수 대칭성 홀수 거듭제곱 법칙 (-k)³ = -k³이므로 |n|이 세제곱수이면 음수 -n도 세제곱수입니다. -512는 ∛(-512) = -8이므로 완전세제곱수입니다. 4 테스트 4: 자릿수 근 (Mod 9) 제외 필터 자릿수를 반복해서 더한 자릿수 근은 세제곱수의 경우 항상 0, 1, 8, 9 중 하나입니다. 1331의 자릿수 근: 1+3+3+1 = 8 (테스트 통과). Step-by-Step Proofs Step-by-Step Worked Verification Examples PERFECT CUBE Example 1: Testing 512 ∛512 = 8 : 8 × 8 × 8 = 512. Prime factorization is 2⁹ with exponent 9 divisible by 3. Digital root: 5 + 1 + 2 = 8 (valid). NOT A CUBE Example 2: Testing 100 ∛100 ≈ 4.642 : 100 sits strictly between 4³ = 64 and 5³ = 125. Prime factors are 2² × 5², neither exponent is divisible by 3. REAL NEGATIVE CUBE Example 3: Testing -216 ∛(-216) = -6 : (-6) × (-6) × (-6) = 36 × (-6) = -216. Odd roots preserve negative signs, producing a valid real integer root. Mental Math Mental Math Shortcuts: The 1-to-1 Last-Digit Bijection Unlike perfect squares (which can only end in 0, 1, 4, 5, 6, or 9), every digit from 0 to 9 can be the last digit of a perfect cube. In fact, there is a strict one-to-one bijection between the ones digit of a base integer and the ones digit of its cube: Base Last Digit (k) Cube Calculation (k³ mod 10) Cube Last Digit (k³) Memory Rule 0 0³ = 0 0 Preserved (Same digit) 1 1³ = 1 1 Preserved (Same digit) 2 2³ = 8 8 Complements to 10 (2 + 8 = 10) 3 3³ = 27 7 Complements to 10 (3 + 7 = 10) 4 4³ = 64 4 Preserved (Same digit) 5 5³ = 125 5 Preserved (Same digit) 6 6³ = 216 6 Preserved (Same digit) 7 7³ = 343 3 Complements to 10 (7 + 3 = 10) 8 8³ = 512 2 Complements to 10 (8 + 2 = 10) 9 9³ = 729 9 Preserved (Same digit) PRO TRICK Extracting Cube Roots of Large Numbers (Up to 1,000,000) in 3 Seconds To find the cube root of 175,616 : 1. Ones Digit: The number ends in 6. Looking at our table, a cube ending in 6 must have a root ending in 6 . 2. Tens Digit: Cross off the last three digits (616), leaving 175 . The largest perfect cube below 175 is 125 (5³). So the tens digit is 5 . Result: ∛175616 = 56 . Verified: 56 × 56 × 56 = 175,616! Special Cases Edge Cases: Zero, Negative Cubes, Fractions, and Decimals Odd powers behave differently from even powers. Here is how special numeric sets are evaluated: 1. Is Zero a Perfect Cube? Yes. 0 is an integer, and 0 × 0 × 0 = 0 (0³ = 0). Its principal cube root is exactly 0. 2. Negative Perfect Cubes Fully Real. Unlike square roots which require the imaginary unit i, odd roots preserve signs: (-k)³ = -k³. For example, ∛(-64) = -4. 3. Rational Fractions A fraction is a cubic power if both its numerator and denominator are perfect cubes: 27/64 = (3/4)³. 4. Finite Decimals Decimals are cubes if the significant digits form a cube and the number of decimal places is a multiple of 3: 0.027 = (0.3)³, 0.000125 = (0.05)³. Mistakes to Avoid Common Mistakes and Misconceptions to Avoid #1 Confusing Cubing with Multiplying by 3 Cubing a number means multiplying it by itself three times (4³ = 4 × 4 × 4 = 64), not multiplying it by three (4 × 3 = 12). #2 Assuming Negative Numbers Cannot Be Cubes Unlike square roots, odd roots preserve negative signs. Multiplying three negative numbers gives a negative product: (-5) × (-5) × (-5) = -125. #3 Trying to Rule Out Cubes by Last Digits Alone Every digit from 0 to 9 can end a perfect cube. You cannot eliminate a candidate by its last digit alone; you must use prime factors or modulo 9 digital roots. #4 Floating-Point Rounding Pitfalls in Calculators In computers, computing 125^(1/3) frequently yields 4.999999999999999. Naively checking if int(125^(1/3)) == 5 can fail without proper rounding logic. 자주 묻는 질문 (FAQ) 자주 묻는 질문 (FAQ) 완전세제곱수란 쉽게 말해 무엇인가요? 어떤 정수를 세 번 곱해서 만들어지는 수입니다. 예를 들어 3 × 3 × 3 = 27이므로 27은 완전세제곱수입니다. 음수도 완전세제곱수가 될 수 있나요? 네! 세 음수를 곱하면 음수가 됩니다: (-4) × (-4) × (-4) = -64. 따라서 -64는 세제곱근이 -4인 완전세제곱수입니다. 0은 완전세제곱수인가요? 네, 0 × 0 × 0 = 0(0³ = 0)이므로 0도 완전세제곱수입니다. 제곱수이면서 동시에 세제곱수인 수도 있나요? 네, 소인수의 지수가 6의 배수인 수들입니다: 1, 64(8² 및 4³), 729(27² 및 9³), 4096(64² 및 16³) 등이 있습니다. 이 계산기는 무료인가요? 네, 저희 완전세제곱수 계산기는 회원가입 없이 100% 무료로 무제한 이용하실 수 있습니다. 작성 및 검증 완료 Syed Muhammad Ahmed 설립자 겸 제작자 핵심 요약 핵심 요약 세 개의 동일한 인수 정수 k에 대해 n = k × k × k 수식을 만족합니다. 음수 허용 제곱근과 달리 음수의 세제곱근은 유효한 실수입니다. 3의 배수 지수 모든 소인수가 3으로 나누어떨어지는 지수를 가집니다. 100% 무료 제한 없이 단계별 풀이와 함께 결과를 즉시 확인하세요.

mainEntity.name: What is a cube root?

acceptedAnswer.text: A cube root of a number is a value that, when multiplied by itself three times, produces the original number. In mathematical notation, the cube root of x is written as ∛x or x^(1/3). For example, the cube root of 27 is 3, because 3 × 3 × 3 = 27.

mainEntity.name: Can you take the cube root of a negative number?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Unlike square roots, cube roots of negative numbers are real numbers because multiplying three negative numbers results in a negative product. The rule is ∛(-x) = -∛x. For example, ∛(-8) = -2, because (-2) × (-2) × (-2) = -8.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between cubing and taking a cube root?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cubing and taking the cube root are inverse operations. Cubing a number means raising it to the power of 3 (for example, 4³ = 64). Taking the cube root reverses this process to recover the original base value: ∛64 = 4.

mainEntity.name: What is a perfect cube?

acceptedAnswer.text: A perfect cube is an integer that results from multiplying an integer by itself three times. Examples include 1, 8, 27, 64, 125, 216, 343, 512, 729, and 1000. The cube root of a perfect cube is always a whole number.

mainEntity.name: How do you calculate a cube root without a calculator?

acceptedAnswer.text: For perfect cubes, use prime factorization: break the number into prime factors, group identical factors into sets of three, and extract one from each group (e.g. 3375 = 3³ × 5³ = 15). For non-perfect cubes, use estimation between the two nearest known perfect cubes.

mainEntity.name: What is the cube root symbol?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cube root symbol is ∛ (Unicode character U+221B). It consists of a standard radical sign with a small index 3 in the upper-left notch. In software code it is written cbrt(x), and in LaTeX as \sqrt[3]{x}.

mainEntity.name: How do you type the cube root symbol?

acceptedAnswer.text: On Windows, type 221B then press Alt+X in supported apps, or use Character Map. On Mac, press Cmd+Ctrl+Space to open Character Viewer and search 'cube root'. In HTML, use the entity ∛ or copy and paste ∛ directly.

mainEntity.name: What is ∛0?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cube root of 0 is exactly 0, because 0 × 0 × 0 = 0.

mainEntity.name: Is the cube root of 2 rational or irrational?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cube root of 2 (∛2 ≈ 1.2599) is an irrational number. It cannot be expressed as an exact fraction of two integers, and its decimal expansion continues infinitely without repeating.

mainEntity.name: What is the cube root of 1?

acceptedAnswer.text: The real cube root of 1 is 1, since 1 × 1 × 1 = 1. (In complex mathematics, there are also two non-real complex cube roots of unity: e^(2πi/3) and e^(-2πi/3)).

A cube root of a number is a value that, when multiplied by itself three times, produces the original number. In mathematical notation, the cube root of x is written as ∛x or x^(1/3). For example, the cube root of 27 is 3, because 3 × 3 × 3 = 27. Can you take the cube root of a negative number? Yes! Unlike square roots, cube roots of negative numbers are real numbers because multiplying three negative numbers results in a negative product. The rule is ∛(-x) = -∛x. For example, ∛(-8) = -2, because (-2) × (-2) × (-2) = -8. What is the difference between cubing and taking a cube root? Cubing and taking the cube root are inverse operations. Cubing a number means raising it to the power of 3 (for example, 4³ = 64). Taking the cube root reverses this process to recover the original base value: ∛64 = 4. What is a perfect cube? A perfect cube is an integer that results from multiplying an integer by itself three times. Examples include 1, 8, 27, 64, 125, 216, 343, 512, 729, and 1000. The cube root of a perfect cube is always a whole number. How do you calculate a cube root without a calculator? For perfect cubes, use prime factorization: break the number into prime factors, group identical factors into sets of three, and extract one from each group (e.g. 3375 = 3³ × 5³ = 15). For non-perfect cubes, use estimation between the two nearest known perfect cubes. What is the cube root symbol? The cube root symbol is ∛ (Unicode character U+221B). It consists of a standard radical sign with a small index 3 in the upper-left notch. In software code it is written cbrt(x), and in LaTeX as \sqrt[3]{x}. How do you type the cube root symbol? On Windows, type 221B then press Alt+X in supported apps, or use Character Map. On Mac, press Cmd+Ctrl+Space to open Character Viewer and search 'cube root'. In HTML, use the entity ∛ or copy and paste ∛ directly. What is ∛0? The cube root of 0 is exactly 0, because 0 × 0 × 0 = 0. Is the cube root of 2 rational or irrational? The cube root of 2 (∛2 ≈ 1.2599) is an irrational number. It cannot be expressed as an exact fraction of two integers, and its decimal expansion continues infinitely without repeating. What is the cube root of 1? The real cube root of 1 is 1, since 1 × 1 × 1 = 1. (In complex mathematics, there are also two non-real complex cube roots of unity: e^(2πi/3) and e^(-2πi/3)). 작성 및 검증 완료 Syed Muhammad Ahmed Founder & Creator 공유:: 맺음말 결론 및 요약 기억해야 할 핵심 세제곱근은 3제곱(x³)의 역연산이며, 양수뿐만 아니라 음수에 대해서도 항상 실수 범위에서 정의됩니다.

mainEntity.name: Bagaimanakah cara menggunakan kalkulator ini?

acceptedAnswer.text: Masukkan nombor di atas dan klik Kira. Hasil perpuluhan tepat, bentuk dipermudah dan langkah pengiraan akan dipaparkan segera.

mainEntity.name: Apakah maksud «racine carrée»?

acceptedAnswer.text: «Racine carrée» ialah bahasa Perancis bagi punca kuasa dua — nombor yang apabila didarabkan dengan dirinya menghasilkan nilai tersebut.

mainEntity.name: Bolehkah kalkulator mengira nombor negatif?

acceptedAnswer.text: Boleh, kalkulator akan memberikan jawapan nombor kompleks menggunakan unit khayalan i (contohnya √(-16) = 4i).

mainEntity.name: Apakah perbezaan antara punca kuasa dua dan punca kuasa tiga?

acceptedAnswer.text: Punca kuasa dua mendarab 2 kali (darjah 2), manakala punca kuasa tiga mendarab 3 kali (darjah 3).

mainEntity.name: Bagaimana mengira punca tanpa kalkulator?

acceptedAnswer.text: Menggunakan pemfaktoran perdana, pembahagian panjang bersusun atau anggaran kaedah Babylon.

mainEntity.name: Apakah nombor kuasa dua sempurna?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nombor bulat yang punca kuasanya ialah nombor bulat (1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, 100).

mainEntity.name: Adakah semua punca kuasa dua nombor nisbah?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tidak, hanya kuasa dua sempurna menghasilkan nombor nisbah. Yang lain menghasilkan nombor bukan nisbah.

mainEntity.name: Adakah kalkulator ini percuma?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ya, ia 100% percuma, tanpa had dan tidak memerlukan sebarang pendaftaran.

mainEntity.name: Bolehkah saya mencari punca bagi pecahan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Boleh, masukkan sebarang nombor perpuluhan atau pecahan ke dalam kalkulator.

mainEntity.name: Apakah itu punca utama?

acceptedAnswer.text: Punca utama ialah nilai bukan negatif yang diwakili oleh simbol √ mengikut konvensyen matematik.

Ia merupakan salah satu topik matematik paling kerap dicari di serata dunia. Punca kuasa dua bagi sesuatu nombor ialah nilai yang apabila didarabkan dengan dirinya sendiri akan menghasilkan nombor asal itu. Jika anda mendarab 7 dengan 7, anda mendapat 49. Jadi punca kuasa dua bagi 49 ialah 7. Secara matematik, punca kuasa dua x ialah nombor y yang memenuhi persamaan y × y = x (atau y² = x). Anatomi Ungkapan Punca Kuasa Click or hover over any part √ 49 = 7 √ Simbol Punca Kuasa (√) Tanda operasi punca kuasa 49 Radikan (Nombor) Nombor di bawah tanda punca (contohnya 49 dalam √49) 7 Punca (Hasil) Nilai jawapan (contohnya 7) √4 = 2 kerana 2 × 2 = 4 √9 = 3 kerana 3 × 3 = 9 √16 = 4 kerana 4 × 4 = 16 √25 = 5 kerana 5 × 5 = 25 √100 = 10 kerana 10 × 10 = 100 Visualisasi: Mencari panjang sisi segi empat sama daripada jumlah luasnya Cara Guna Cara Menggunakan Kalkulator Punca Kuasa Dua Dapatkan jawapan anda dalam tiga langkah mudah: 1 Taip Nombor Anda Masukkan sebarang nombor ke dalam kotak input di atas. 2 Klik Kira Tekan butang Kira untuk memproses nombor anda secara pantas. 3 Lihat Hasil Jawapan Kalkulator memaparkan nilai perpuluhan tepat, bentuk dipermudah (contoh √72 = 6√2) dan jalan kerja. Alat ini memudahkan pengiraan tanpa perlu mengingati rumus rumit. Notasi & Indeks Notasi Punca Kuasa Dua: Simbol √ dan x^(1/2) Simbol √ ialah tanda punca kuasa piawai. √36 bertanyakan nombor apakah yang didarabkan dengan dirinya sendiri menghasilkan 36. Jawapannya ialah 6. √ Simbol punca kuasa 36 Nombor radikan 6 Nilai punca utama Setiap ungkapan terdiri daripada simbol punca, radikan dan nilai punca. Punca kuasa dua juga boleh ditulis dalam bentuk indeks pecahan: Bentuk Punca (√x) Bentuk Indeks (x^½) Kod / Sintaks √x = y  ⟺  y² = x Standard mathematical radical sign x^(1/2) = √x  ⟺  49^(1/2) = 7 Fractional power notation used in advanced algebra Math.sqrt(x) /* JavaScript */  |  x ** 0.5 /* Python */ Syntax used in programming and scientific calculators Kedua-dua bentuk membawa erti yang sama. Bahasa komputer sering menggunakan x^(1/2). Kesetaraan antara simbol √x dan bentuk indeks pecahan x^(1/2) Rumus Asas Apakah Rumus Punca Kuasa Dua? Punca kuasa dua ditakrifkan oleh hubungan songsangan: If y = √x, then y × y = x  (or y² = x) Nombor yang diperoleh apabila didarab dengan dirinya sendiri mestilah menghasilkan nombor permulaan. Konvensyen Punca Kuasa Utama Punca utama adalah nilai bukan negatif. Walaupun 5 dan -5 dikuasaduakan menjadi 25, secara piawai √25 = 5. Principal Root √25 = +5 Dual Algebraic Solutions x² = 25 ⇒ x = ±5 Hukum Punca Kuasa Lima Hukum Penting Punca Kuasa Dua Hukum-hukum ini memudahkan pemudahan ungkapan algebra: 1 1. Hukum Pendaraban √(a × b) = √a × √b (untuk a ≥ 0, b ≥ 0) √(a × b) = √a × √b Contoh: √(4 × 9) = √4 × √9 = 2 × 3 = 6. Terus: √36 = 6. Membolehkan faktor dipisahkan untuk dipermudahkan (contoh √72 = 6√2). 2 2. Hukum Pembahagian √(a / b) = √a / √b (untuk a ≥ 0, b > 0) √(a ÷ b) = √a ÷ √b Contoh: √(16/4) = √16 / √4 = 4 / 2 = 2. Terus: √4 = 2. Punca kuasa bagi pecahan boleh dicari secara berasingan bagi pengangka dan penyebut. 3 3. Hukum Kuasa √(a²) = |a| (nilai mutlak a) √(a²) = |a| Contoh: √(7²) = √49 = 7. Kuasa dua dan punca kuasa saling membatalkan. Mengembalikan nilai mutlak nombor asal. 4 4. Pendaraban Kendiri √a × √a = a √a × √a = a Contoh: √13 × √13 = 13. √5 × √5 = 5. Mendarab punca dengan dirinya sendiri menghapuskan tanda punca (menisbahkan penyebut: 1/√5 = √5/5). 5 5. Punca Bersarang √(√a) = a^(1/4) (punca kuasa empat) √(√a) = a^(1/4) Contoh: √(√16) = √4 = 2. Dan 16^(1/4) = 2. Punca kuasa daripada punca kuasa menghasilkan punca kuasa empat.
